title: Countable and uncountable nouns
summary: Неисчисляемые существительные, которые русскоязычные часто считают исчисляемыми (advice, information, research, luggage), слова с двумя значениями (paper / a paper, glass / glasses) и конструкции типа a piece of.
ru:
## Исчисляемые и неисчисляемые: за пределами базы
Вы уже знаете, что *a book — books*, но *water* без **a** и без **-s**. На продвинутом уровне сложности создают слова, которые в русском исчисляемы, а в английском — нет. Это самый частый источник ошибок.
- **Неисчисляемые в английском**: *advice, information, news, research, evidence, progress, luggage / baggage, equipment, furniture, knowledge, traffic, scenery, accommodation, homework, behaviour*.
> She gave me some useful **advice**. — Она дала мне полезный совет. (~~an advice / advices~~)
> The police need more **evidence**. — Полиции нужно больше доказательств.
> We made good **progress** this week. — На этой неделе мы хорошо продвинулись.

## Единицы счёта: a piece of, an item of
Чтобы посчитать такое существительное, используют слова-«единицы»: **a piece of** (advice, news, information, furniture, equipment), **an item of** (news, clothing, luggage), **a bit of** (разг.), **a stroke of** (luck), **an article of** (clothing).
> **a piece of news** — одна новость · **two items of luggage** — два места багажа
> **a word of advice** — совет · **a bit of information** — немного информации

## Слова с двумя значениями
Многие слова ведут себя по-разному в зависимости от значения: в общем смысле — неисчисляемые, в конкретном — исчисляемые.
- **paper** (бумага) / **a paper** (газета; научная статья; документ)
- **glass** (стекло) / **a glass** (стакан) / **glasses** (очки)
- **experience** (опыт вообще) / **an experience** (случай, переживание)
- **work** (работа) / **a work** (произведение: *a work of art*)
- **time** (время) / **a time / times** (раз, эпоха): *three times*, *in difficult times*
- **hair**: *She has dark hair.* / *I found a hair in my soup.* (отдельный волос)
> I've got no **experience** of managing a team, but it was a great **experience** to try. — Опыта управления командой у меня нет, но попробовать было отличным опытом.
> **Coffee** is expensive. / Two **coffees**, please. — Кофе дорогой. / Два кофе, пожалуйста.

## Существительные, которые всегда во множественном числе
К этой группе относятся **clothes, goods, belongings, savings, surroundings, outskirts, earnings, remains, arms (оружие)**. У них нет единственного числа, и согласуются они с глаголом во множ. числе.
> His **belongings were** scattered across the room. — Его вещи были разбросаны по комнате.
Но **a pair of trousers / scissors / glasses** — единственное число (*pair* — единица счёта).

## Выглядят как множественные, но единственное число
**news, economics, physics, politics, mathematics, athletics, measles**: *The news is good. Economics was my favourite subject.* Исключение по смыслу: *politics* в значении «взгляды» может стоять во множественном (*His politics are controversial*).

## Количественные слова: much / many, less / fewer, amount / number
- **неисчисляемые**: *much, little, less, a great deal of, amount of*
- **исчисляемые**: *many, few, fewer, a number of*
> There was **less traffic** and **fewer cars** than usual. — Машин и движения было меньше, чем обычно.
В разговорной речи **less** часто употребляют и с исчисляемыми (*less people*), но в формальном английском это считается ошибкой.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Could you give me an advice?~~ → Could you give me **some advice** / **a piece of advice**?
- ~~We have got a lot of informations.~~ → We have got a lot of **information**.
- ~~Her luggages were heavy.~~ → Her **luggage was** heavy.
- ~~The news are shocking.~~ → The news **is** shocking.
- ~~I need a paper to write on.~~ → I need **some paper** to write on. (если имеется в виду бумага, а не документ)
en:
## Beyond the basics
You know that *a book — books*, but *water* has no **a** and no **-s**. At an advanced level the problems come from words that are countable in your language but uncountable in English. This is one of the most common sources of mistakes.
- **Uncountable in English**: *advice, information, news, research, evidence, progress, luggage / baggage, equipment, furniture, knowledge, traffic, scenery, accommodation, homework, behaviour*.
> She gave me some useful **advice**. (~~an advice / advices~~)
> The police need more **evidence**.
> We made good **progress** this week.

## Counting units: a piece of, an item of
To count these nouns we use unit words: **a piece of** (advice, news, information, furniture, equipment), **an item of** (news, clothing, luggage), **a bit of** (informal), **a stroke of** (luck), **an article of** (clothing).
> **a piece of news** · **two items of luggage** · **a word of advice** · **a bit of information**

## Words with two meanings
Many nouns are uncountable in a general sense and countable in a specific one.
- **paper** (the material) / **a paper** (a newspaper; an academic article; a document)
- **glass** (the material) / **a glass** (for drinking) / **glasses** (spectacles)
- **experience** (general knowledge from doing something) / **an experience** (an event you lived through)
- **work** (employment, effort) / **a work** (a creation: *a work of art*)
- **time** (general) / **a time / times** (occasions, periods): *three times*, *in difficult times*
- **hair**: *She has dark hair.* / *I found a hair in my soup.*
> **Coffee** is expensive. / Two **coffees**, please.

## Plural-only nouns
**clothes, goods, belongings, savings, surroundings, outskirts, earnings, remains, arms (weapons)** have no singular and take a plural verb.
> His **belongings were** scattered across the room.
But **a pair of trousers / scissors / glasses** is singular, because *pair* is the counting unit.

## Look plural, are singular
**news, economics, physics, politics, mathematics, athletics, measles**: *The news is good. Economics was my favourite subject.* An exception: *politics* meaning 'opinions' can be plural (*His politics are controversial*).

## much / many, less / fewer, amount / number
- **uncountable**: *much, little, less, a great deal of, amount of*
- **countable**: *many, few, fewer, a number of*
> There was **less traffic** and **fewer cars** than usual.
In informal English **less** is often used with countable nouns (*less people*), but formal English prefers **fewer**.

## Common mistakes
- ~~Could you give me an advice?~~ → Could you give me **some advice** / **a piece of advice**?
- ~~We have got a lot of informations.~~ → We have got a lot of **information**.
- ~~Her luggages were heavy.~~ → Her **luggage was** heavy.
- ~~The news are shocking.~~ → The news **is** shocking.
structure:
## Неисчисляемые и их «единицы»
| Неисчисляемое | Единица счёта | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| advice | a piece / word of advice | She gave me a **piece of advice**. |
| information | a piece / bit of information | One **bit of information** was missing. |
| news | a piece / item of news | That's an interesting **piece of news**. |
| luggage | an item / piece of luggage | Two **items of luggage** per person. |
| furniture | a piece of furniture | an antique **piece of furniture** |
| equipment | a piece / item of equipment | a useful **piece of equipment** |

## Слова с двумя значениями
| Неисчисляемое | Исчисляемое |
|---|---|
| paper (бумага) | a paper (газета, статья) |
| glass (стекло) | a glass (стакан), glasses (очки) |
| experience (опыт) | an experience (случай) |
| work (работа) | a work (произведение) |
| hair (волосы) | a hair (отдельный волос) |
| chicken (мясо) | a chicken (птица) |

## Количественные слова
| С исчисляемыми | С неисчисляемыми |
|---|---|
| many, few, fewer | much, little, less |
| a number of, several | an amount of, a great deal of |
| a few, a couple of | a little, a bit of |

## Согласование
> **The news is** good. · **Economics is** hard. · **The police are** here. · **My clothes are** wet.

exercises.title: Единицы счёта
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужное слово: **piece, pieces, item, items, bit, bits, word, stroke**. Ответ должен подходить по смыслу и грамматике.
exercises.example: I'd like to give you a ___ of advice. → a **piece** of advice

items.text: Each passenger may take two {{items|pieces}} of hand luggage.
That's a useful {{piece|bit|item}} of information, thank you.
Let me give you a {{word}} of warning before you sign.
The article contained several {{pieces|items|bits}} of evidence that nobody had noticed.
Winning the lottery was a real {{stroke|piece|bit}} of luck.
She bought only one {{piece|item}} of furniture: a small desk.
Here is an interesting {{item|piece}} of news from the local paper.

exercises.title: Глагол: is или are?
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол **be** в нужную форму (в настоящем времени, если в подсказке не указано иное).

items.text: Economics {{is}} a compulsory course at our faculty.
The goods {{are}} due to arrive on Thursday.
A pair of old trousers {{was}} lying on the floor.
The surroundings {{are}} breathtaking at this time of year.

items.q: Could you give me ___ before I decide?
items.why: advice неисчисляемое: some advice или a piece of advice.

items.q: There ___ too many people in the hall.
We didn't have ___ about the schedule.
We still need more ___ before we publish the findings.
items.why: research неисчисляемое: без -es и без артикля.

items.q: I need ___ to wrap this present.
items.why: Бумага как материал неисчисляема: some paper.

items.q: She was wearing ___ on her face. (очки)
items.why: Очки — всегда glasses; a pair of glasses.

items.q: This year we've had ___ rain than last year.
items.why: rain неисчисляемое, поэтому less, а не fewer.
luggage неисчисляемое: без -s и с глаголом в единственном числе.

options: The furnitures in the flat are modern.
The furniture in the flat is modern.
The furniture in the flat are modern.
items.why: furniture неисчисляемое: единственное число и is.

options: He gave me an excellent advice.
He gave me an excellent piece of advice.
items.why: a piece of advice — единица счёта; an advice невозможно.

options: I had a wonderful experience in Japan.
I had a wonderful experiences in Japan.
I had an wonderful experience in Japan.
items.why: an experience (случай, событие) исчисляемо: a wonderful experience.
news выглядит как множественное, но согласуется как единственное.

options: There are fewer cars in the centre these days.
There is fewer cars in the centre these days.
There are less car in the centre these days.
items.why: Исчисляемое во множественном числе → fewer + are.

exercises.title: Исправьте предложения
exercises.instruction: Каждое предложение содержит ошибку, связанную с исчисляемостью. Перепишите его верно.

items.prompt: I have to buy some new furnitures for my office.
answers: I have to buy some new furniture for my office.
I have to buy some new pieces of furniture for my office.

items.prompt: Can you give me some informations about the course?
answers: Can you give me some information about the course.
Can you give me some information about the course?

items.prompt: She made a lot of progresses last term.
answers: She made a lot of progress last term.
She made lots of progress last term.
Your luggage is too heavy.

items.prompt: The news about the merger are surprising.
answers: The news about the merger is surprising.

items.prompt: There is less people than I expected.
answers: There are fewer people than I expected.
There are not as many people as I expected.
There aren't as many people as I expected.

exercises.title: Перефразирование
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя слово в скобках и единицу счёта.

items.prompt: I have a suggestion for you. (advice) → I'd like to give you ...
answers: I'd like to give you a piece of advice.
I would like to give you a piece of advice.
I'd like to give you a word of advice.
I would like to give you a word of advice.

items.prompt: The manager told us something new. (news) → The manager told us ...
answers: The manager told us a piece of news.
The manager told us an item of news.
The manager told us some news.

items.prompt: She checked in two bags. (luggage) → She checked in two ...
answers: She checked in two pieces of luggage.
She checked in two items of luggage.

items.prompt: They bought a table. (furniture) → They bought a ...
answers: They bought a piece of furniture.
They bought an item of furniture.

items.prompt: She has found a new fact. (information) → She has found a ...
answers: She has found a piece of information.
She has found a bit of information.
She has found an item of information.
She has found a new piece of information.
She has found a new bit of information.

items.prompt: There are not many cars on the road. (traffic) → There is ...
answers: There is little traffic on the road.
There is not much traffic on the road.
There isn't much traffic on the road.
There is not a lot of traffic on the road.
There isn't a lot of traffic on the road.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, следя за исчисляемостью.

items.prompt: Какой лучший совет вы когда-либо получали? (a piece of advice)
items.sample: The best piece of advice I've ever had was to save a little money every month.

items.prompt: Сколько багажа вы берёте в короткую поездку? (luggage)
items.sample: I usually take only one small bag, so I have very little luggage.

items.prompt: Расскажите о своём интересном опыте. (an experience)
items.sample: Learning to dive was an unforgettable experience for me.

items.prompt: Какие новости вы читаете каждый день? (news)
items.sample: I read the news on my phone every morning, mostly about technology.
